title: Linxira Bio runtime backend preferences
description: Benchmark-derived default backends per capability and dataset class (ROADMAP M2-T7). Written back by benchmark tooling; consulted by the worker and the CLI when a request carries no explicit backend. Only consistent benchmark verdicts may drive a default.

dataset_class.description: Data class the measurement was taken on (e.g. sequence, matrix, srr). Informational for resolution: the worker matches by capability, first entry wins.

measured.description: Median wall-time and peak RSS per backend key (rust, python, r) from the source benchmark report.

speedup.description: median_wall(default_backend) / median_wall(rust); null when the default is rust.
